description: This file defines an abstract class 'EventLoop' used for managing an event processing thread, including starting, stopping, posting events, and handling errors within the Spark framework.

classes.name: EventLoop
classes.description: An abstract class providing a thread-based event processing loop with lifecycle management and error handling.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts the event thread after invoking onStart.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the event thread, invoking onStop after thread termination.

methods.name: post
methods.description: Enqueues an event for processing by the event thread.

methods.name: isActive
methods.description: Checks if the event thread is currently active.

methods.name: onStart
methods.description: Hook invoked before the event thread starts.

methods.name: onStop
methods.description: Hook invoked after the event thread stops.

methods.name: onReceive
methods.description: Abstract method called when an event is received in the event thread.

methods.name: onError
methods.description: Hook called when an error occurs during event processing.
